scientific_integrity: The norm identity and its Banach quotient and Hamming face-count consequences have complete finite-dimensional proofs. Explicit exact-arithmetic checks are corroborating evidence only. Known source definitions and distance-matrix structure are credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite full Cartesian products with sum metrics only; no assertion for arbitrary subsets or infinite products.
Vertex/facet formulas refer to double-point quotient unit balls, not ordinary transportation-cost unit balls.
The matrix-product literature may independently cover part of the kernel dimension calculation; no novelty is attributed to that rank fact alone.
Bibliographic search is not a proof of absolute novelty; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: Exact double-point transportation quotients of finite metric products
